bug_semantics: POST /permission (PermissionSaveController::save) takes request-supplied role IDs and permission names and calls Role::syncPermissions with no authorize()/can()/role gate, so any caller who can hit the endpoint can grant any role, including their own, arbitrary application permissions.
flaw_origin: PR #169 first-write b0fa7751b112038cb01a0fac3b2ab841f2f7f7cc added PermissionSaveController extending Controller and a POST /permission route; save() loops $request->roles into syncPermissions with no authorization. GitHub squash ac1919b745e0fd22973853954e8c92b1393f0920 is the same controller blob, not a first-write. Later 52e5e1938 only switched the parent class to MainController (authentication), leaving the unguarded sync intact.
